transcript.text: How do you usually tell whether
something isn't working or if it just
hasn't been seen yet?
>> For example, if I say I'm going to make
content on social media for my plumbing
business and I make content and I don't
get customers, the fundamental
assumption is that people who need
plumbing work exist on social media. Has
that been disproven? No. Okay, then I
just need to do more volume and get
better at it. If all of a sudden I find
out that plumbing clients are not on
Instagram, then yeah, I would stop
making content and find out where they
are and start doing something else.
[music] If there's an underlying
assumption that is required for it to
work that gets disproven while you work,
then it's something that's worth
pivoting from. Most of the times your
assumptions like those, especially with
the big things in business, are often
not wrong. It's just your execution is
just not good enough and not enough of
it and not long enough.
